queries.key: INSERT INTO water_daily(station_id,day,min_level,max_level,mean_level,samples) SELECT station_id,DATE(observed_at),MIN(water_level),MAX(water_level),AVG(water_level),COUNT(water_level) FROM water_readings WHERE observed_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL # HOUR-INTERVAL # DAY GROUP BY station_id,DATE(observed_at) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE min_level=VALUES(min_level),max_level=VALUES(max_level),mean_level=VALUES(mean_level),samples=VALUES(samples)

SELECT s.station_id,s.station_name,s.external_station_id,s.latitude,s.longitude,t.*,w.water_level,DATE_FORMAT(w.observed_at,?) observed_at FROM stations s JOIN flood_thresholds t ON t.station_id=s.station_id LEFT JOIN water_readings w ON w.reading_id=(SELECT reading_id FROM water_readings WHERE station_id=s.station_id ORDER BY observed_at DESC,reading_id DESC LIMIT #) WHERE s.data_source=?

SELECT s.station_id,s.station_name,s.external_station_id,s.data_source, w.observed_at,w.water_level,w.source_url AS observation_source_url,t.interest_level_m,t.caution_level_m,t.alert_level_m,t.severe_level_m, t.advisory_level_m,t.warning_level_m,t.verification_status,t.verified_at,t.source_url,t.reference_source, l.river_id FROM stations s JOIN flood_thresholds t ON t.station_id=s.station_id LEFT JOIN water_readings w ON w.station_id=s.station_id AND w.observed_at=(SELECT MAX(w2.observed_at) FROM water_readings w2 WHERE w2.station_id=s.station_id) LEFT JOIN river_gauge_links l ON l.station_id=s.station_id AND l.verification_status=? WHERE s.

SELECT f.valid_at,f.rainfall_forecast FROM weather_forecasts f JOIN stations s ON s.station_id=f.station_id WHERE s.data_source=? AND s.external_station_id=? AND f.issued_at=(SELECT MAX(f2.issued_at) FROM weather_forecasts f2 WHERE f2.station_id=f.station_id) ORDER BY f.valid_at DESC LIMIT #

INSERT INTO aws_rainfall_readings ( aws_station_code, observed_at, hourly_rainfall, daily_rainfall ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hourly_rainfall = COALESCE( VALUES(hourly_rainfall), hourly_rainfall ), daily_rainfall = COALESCE( VALUES(daily_rainfall), daily_rainfall )
INSERT INTO risk_assessments(station_id,assessed_at,risk_level,risk_score,reason,method_version,input_observed_at,evidence_json) VALUES(?,UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL # HOUR,?,?,?,?,?,?)

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, s.external_station_id, (SELECT MAX(w.observed_at) FROM water_readings w WHERE w.station_id = s.station_id) AS latest_observed_at FROM stations s WHERE s.data_source = ? AND s.external_station_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT # FROM river_gauge_links l WHERE l.station_id = s.station_id AND l.verification_status = ? ) ORDER BY s.station_id

SELECT p.* FROM stations station JOIN prediction_history p ON p.prediction_id=(SELECT p2.prediction_id FROM prediction_history p2 WHERE p2.station_id=station.station_id ORDER BY p2.observed_at DESC,(p2.status=?) DESC,p2.prediction_id DESC LIMIT #)

SELECT r.aws_station_code AS external_station_id,r.gauge_name AS station_name,r.latitude,r.longitude,r.source_url AS coordinate_source_url,a.hourly_rainfall,a.observed_at FROM rainfall_stations r LEFT JOIN aws_rainfall_readings a ON a.aws_station_code=r.aws_station_code AND a.observed_at=(SELECT MAX(observed_at) FROM aws_rainfall_readings WHERE aws_station_code=r.aws_station_code)

SELECT report FROM ml_model_versions WHERE prediction_type=? ORDER BY created_at DESC,model_version DESC LIMIT #

SELECT s.station_id, s.station_name, s.latitude, s.longitude, w.observed_at, w.water_level, w.flow_rate FROM stations s JOIN (SELECT station_id, MAX(observed_at) AS observed_at FROM water_readings GROUP BY station_id) lw ON lw.station_id = s.station_id JOIN water_readings w ON w.station_id = lw.station_id AND w.observed_at = lw.observed_at WHERE s.data_source IN (?, ?) ORDER BY s.station_name
